_doc: Cyber Wand BLE remote-control protocol descriptor (PUBLIC EXAMPLE / PLACEHOLDER).
All values here are FAKE. They only let the project compile cleanly.
To run against a real peer device, copy this file to 'protocol.json'
(gitignored) and fill in the real values. The build script auto-generates

ble._doc: GATT server parameters announced by the wand.

_doc: Application framing on top of GATT.
head_length already includes 3 B head + 1 B cmd + 1 B end|sn + 1 B size = 6

commands._doc: Command bytes used by both directions (rx_*/tx_*).

_doc: Vendor-specific manufacturer advertisement, used in 'paired' state.
manufacturer-data layout: [prefix N B][token token_length B][suffix M B]
prefix already includes the leading CompanyID (2 B little-endian).
While paired and disconnected, the wand alternates between this wakeup
adv and a normal discoverable adv every rotate_period_ms, so that:
- the originally paired peer can be hardware-woken via the embedded SN,
- any other peer can still discover the wand by GAP name in the
normal-adv slice and pair with it.

modes._doc: Sub-mode IDs cycled through on each tx_set_mode command.
